sources.title: USGS confirms earthquake shook Lakes Region on Black Friday

en.title: USGS confirms earthquake shook Lakes Region on Black Friday, according to WMUR
en.dek: WMUR reports USGS confirmed earthquake in Lakes Region on Black Friday
facts: WMUR reported the USGS confirmed an earthquake shook the Lakes Region on Black Friday.
WHDH reported a 2.5 magnitude earthquake shook Laconia, New Hampshire.
Both WMUR and WHDH published their reports on November 27, 2026.
body: WMUR reported that the United States Geological Survey confirmed an earthquake shook the Lakes Region on Black Friday.
WHDH reported that a 2.5 magnitude earthquake shook Laconia, New Hampshire.
en.context: WMUR and WHDH are local news outlets that reported on the earthquake on the same day.

fr.title: USGS confirme un séisme dans la région des lacs le Black Friday, selon WMUR
fr.dek: WMUR rapporte la confirmation par l'USGS d'un séisme dans la région des lacs le Black Friday
facts: WMUR a rapporté que l'USGS avait confirmé un séisme ayant secoué la région des lacs le Black Friday.
WHDH a rapporté un séisme de magnitude 2,5 ayant secoué Laconia, au New Hampshire.
Les deux médias WMUR et WHDH ont publié leurs rapports le 27 novembre 2026.
body: La United States Geological Survey a confirmé qu'un séisme avait frappé la région des lacs le Black Friday, selon WMUR.
WHDH a rapporté qu'un séisme de magnitude 2,5 avait secoué Laconia, dans le New Hampshire.
fr.context: WMUR et WHDH sont des médias locaux qui ont rapporté le séisme le même jour.

es.title: USGS confirma terremoto en la Región de los Lagos el viernes negro, según WMUR
es.dek: WMUR informa que USGS confirmó terremoto en la Región de los Lagos el viernes negro
facts: WMUR informó que USGS confirmó un terremoto que sacudió la Región de los Lagos el viernes negro
WHDH informó un terremoto de magnitud 2,5 que sacudió Laconia, Nueva Hampshire
Ambos, WMUR y WHDH, publicaron sus informes el 27 de noviembre de 2026
body: La USGS confirmó un terremoto que sacudió la Región de los Lagos el viernes negro, según WMUR.
WHDH informó que un terremoto de magnitud 2.5 sacudió Laconia, New Hampshire.
es.context: WMUR y WHDH son medios de comunicación locales que informaron sobre el terremoto el mismo día

it.title: USGS conferma terremoto nella Lakes Region il Black Friday, secondo WMUR
it.dek: WMUR riferisce che l'USGS ha confermato un terremoto nella Lakes Region il Black Friday
facts: WMUR ha riferito che l'USGS ha confermato un terremoto che ha scosso la Lakes Region il Black Friday
WHDH ha riferito un terremoto di magnitudo 2.5 a Laconia, New Hampshire
Entrambi WMUR e WHDH hanno pubblicato i loro articoli il 27 novembre 2026
body: WMUR ha riportato che l'United States Geological Survey ha confermato un terremoto che ha scosso la Lakes Region il Black Friday.
WHDH ha riferito che un terremoto di magnitudo 2,5 ha scosso Laconia, New Hampshire.
it.context: WMUR e WHDH sono outlet di informazione locali che hanno riportato il terremoto nello stesso giorno

zh.title: 美国地质调查局确认地震袭击了周五的湖区，据WMUR报道
zh.dek: WMUR报道称美国地质调查局确认周五湖区发生地震
facts: WMUR报道称美国地质调查局确认周五湖区发生地震
WHDH报道称2.5级地震袭击了新罕布什尔州拉科尼亚
两家媒体均于2026年11月27日报道了此事
body: 美国地质调查局确认，周五“黑色星期五”期间，一次地震袭击了新罕布什尔州的湖区。
WMUR 报道称，WHDH 报道说，一次 2.5 级地震袭击了新罕布什尔州拉克利亚市。
zh.context: WMUR和WHDH是报道此次地震的地方新闻媒体

ja.title: USGS確認ブラックフライデーにレイクス地域で地震
ja.dek: WMURがUSGSによるレイクス地域での地震を確認
facts: WMURはUSGSがブラックフライデーにレイクス地域で地震が発生したと確認したと報じた
WHDHはニューハンプシャー州ラコニアでマグニチュード2.5の地震が発生したと報じた
両メディアは2026年11月27日に報道した
body: WMURは、アメリカ地質調査所（USGS）がブラックフライデーにレイクス地域で地震が発生したと確認したと報じました。
WHDHは、マグニチュード2.5の地震がニューハンプシャー州ラコニアで発生したと報じました。
ja.context: WMURとWHDHは同日、地震の報道を行った地元ニュース局

ko.title: USGS 확인, 블랙프라이데이에 레이크스 지역 강진
ko.dek: WMUR, USGS가 블랙프라이데이 레이크스 지역에서 지진 확인 보도
facts: WMUR이 USGS가 블랙프라이데이 레이크스 지역에서 지진이 발생했다고 확인했다고 보도함
WHDH가 뉴햄프셔주 라코니아에서 규모 2.5 지진이 발생했다고 보도함
두 매체는 2026년 11월 27일에 보도함
body: 미국지질조사국은 블랙프라이데이에 레이크스 지역에서 지진이 발생했음을 확인했다고 WMUR이 보도했다.
WHDH는 뉴햄프셔주 라코니아에서 규모 2.5의 지진이 발생했다고 보도했다.
ko.context: WMUR과 WHDH는 같은 날 지진에 대해 보도한 지역 뉴스 매체임

pt.title: USGS confirma tremor na região dos Lagos na Black Friday, segundo o WMUR
pt.dek: O WMUR reporta que o USGS confirmou tremor na região dos Lagos na Black Friday
facts: WMUR reportou que o USGS confirmou um tremor que abalou a região dos Lagos na Black Friday
WHDH reportou um tremor de magnitude 2,5 que abalou Laconia, New Hampshire
Ambos o WMUR e o WHDH publicaram os seus relatórios em 27 de novembro de 2026
body: A WMUR reportou que o United States Geological Survey confirmou um terramoto na Região dos Lagos na Black Friday.
A WHDH reportou que um terramoto de magnitude 2,5 abalou Laconia, New Hampshire.
pt.context: O WMUR e o WHDH são órgãos de comunicação social locais que reportaram o tremor no mesmo dia

de.title: USGS bestätigt Erdbeben im Lakes Region am Schwarzen Freitag
de.dek: WMUR berichtet: USGS bestätigt Erdbeben im Lakes Region am Schwarzen Freitag
facts: WMUR berichtete, dass das USGS ein Erdbeben im Lakes Region am Schwarzen Freitag bestätigte.
WHDH berichtete von einem Erdbeben der Stärke 2,5 in Laconia, New Hampshire.
Beide WMUR und WHDH veröffentlichten ihre Berichte am 27. November 2026.
body: Das United States Geological Survey bestätigte, dass ein Erdbeben die Lakes Region am Schwarzen Freitag erschütterte.
WHDH berichtete, dass ein Erdbeben der Stärke 2,5 Laconia, New Hampshire, erschütterte.
de.context: WMUR und WHDH sind lokale Nachrichtenmedien, die am selben Tag über das Erdbeben berichteten.

problemsFixed: Headline lacks attribution to sources (USGS/WMUR/WHDH) as required by style guide point 2.
Dek references 'USGS confirmed' without naming the outlet that reported the confirmation (WMUR).
Facts list includes invented date 'November 27, 2026' — the sources provide timestamps but no explicit calendar date for the event beyond the publication dates.
Body paragraph 3 contains evaluative summary 'The reports differed in the details they included' which violates style guide point 12 (do not restate/evaluate).
Context paragraph uses passive construction and vague phrasing 'the USGS confirmed the earthquake' without naming the reporting outlet, violating point 15.
Category 'science' is inaccurate for an earthquake report; 'community' or 'world' is more appropriate.
Importance value 3 is unsupported; style guide requires factual grounding, not arbitrary scoring.
Body ends with an evaluative summary sentence violating point 12.
